intelligence.enrichment: A solution is a uniform mixture formed when two or more substances mix so that the components are evenly distributed and not visible separately; a non-uniform mixture has components that are not evenly distributed. Even distribution of components causes the mixture to be classified as a solution; uneven distribution causes it to be classified as non-uniform. The learner correctly applies this rule: A solution is a uniform mixture formed when two or more substances mix so that the components are evenly distributed and not visible separately; a non-uniform mixture has components that are not evenly distributed. Any solid stirred into water becomes a solution, so sand-water and sugar-water are both solutions.
